newsitem.title: USA: Marvel says Toy Biz dispute may go to court.
newsitem.headline: Marvel says Toy Biz dispute may go to court.

text.p: Marvel Entertainment Group Inc on Monday reiterated its intention to place a new majority on the Toy Biz Inc board, and said the matter may have to be resolved in court.

"We strongly believe that we have the right to replace the majority of Toy Biz board members," Marvel spokesman Paul Caminiti said in an interview. "We have an extremely sound legal position on this matter."
Toy Biz earlier Monday put out a news release denying Marvel's claim that it controls 70 percent of Toy Biz's stock.

Toy Biz said that when a group of bondholders took control of Marvel on Friday, Marvel's super-voting rights associated with Toy Biz shares it holds were terminated, leaving Marvel with effective control of only 27 percent of Toy Biz shares.
Toy Biz said Marvel therefore could not name a new majority to the Toy Biz board. Toy Biz added that it would resist any such move with "appropriate legal action."
Marvel's Caminiti echoed that last point, saying a court may have to make the final determination in this matter.
Toy Biz shares were down 1/8 to 8-3/4 in midday New York Stock Exchange trading. Marvel shares were up 1/2 to 2-5/8.
